$comment: Project-level rally auto-coordination hooks. Ships WITH the repo so it works on any user machine with NO global ~/.claude/settings.json change. ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} resolves to this repo root on any machine. The hook self-gates on .rally/ presence (no-op if absent) and fail-opens (never blocks an edit). Advisory/non-blocking by default; set RALLY_HOOK_STRICT=1 to hard-block on conflicts. Claude Code prompts to trust these on first use. Cadence parity with Codex (.codex/hooks.json): SessionStart=enter, UserPromptSubmit=per-turn presence refresh (idle), PreToolUse=before-write (kept edit-scoped on purpose — avoids firing on every read/bash tool), Stop=after-write. See docs/AUTO-COORDINATION-HOOKS.md.
